channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Wins this period: Perimeter Insect Guard's Warmkraft unit plans a $16M defense-related facility in Mayagüez creating 56 jobs, and Taiwan's PharmaEssentia plans a US$46M biopharma plant near San Juan. Smaller signs of outside interest include H&M planning a fourth store and a Pennsylvania company relocating to the island. Federal awards of up to $1M also landed for two hospitals. The Oversight Board's quarterly report shows the Economic Activity Index down 0.2%, with about $56.2B in federal recovery funds still undisbursed, and the Medicaid funding cliff in 2027 remains a fiscal risk. On energy, ATCO's merger with Emera does not change LUMA operations, but high power costs and generation shortfalls continue to weigh on the investment climate.
